answer: Standing evaporates unless re-bought, and the rent rises with every sibling. The haven is a registry that pools identities sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint into one cluster. An inlet, one claimed identity, keeps its vote only while it holds a bridge, a one-epoch lease burned at expiry. The k-th inlet in a cluster pays k² credits per bridge each epoch, so an honest inlet pays 1 credit while 100 clones burn 338,350 credits every epoch, forever. Clones escaping the haven's clustering, or votes worth more than the rent, break it.
